description: Working-class New Yorkers are fed up, and so am I. New Yorkers are being taxed to death, and the Democrats in Albany don’t care. They’ve turned our state into a piggy bank for their progressive pet projects while hard-working families and businesses foot the bill. It’s a disgrace. Our state budget has ballooned to a record-breaking quarter-trillion dollars—a progressive spending spree that’s twice the size of Florida’s budget and more than Texas and Florida combined. Yet, what do we get for it?
title: Taxed to Death: Democrats Are Bleeding New York Dry
